question: Please calculate the race completion percentage of Japanese drivers from 2007 to 2009.
evidence: from 2007 to 2009 refers to year between 2007 and 2009; race completion refers to time is not null; percentage = Divide(COUNT(DriverID where time is not null and year between 2007 and 2009),Count (DriverID where year between 2007 and 2009))*100;
clarification: Count each distinct raceId only once.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(NOT T1.time IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.raceId) FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T1.driverId = T3.driverId WHERE T3.nationality = 'Japanese' AND T2.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.time IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.raceId) FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 on T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 on T1.driverId = T3.driverId WHERE T3.nationality = 'Japanese' AND T2.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

d.request: What percentage of distinct races involving Japanese drivers from 2007 through 2009 had at least one Japanese driver finish (a non-null time), counting each raceId only once?
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN res.time IS NOT NULL THEN res.raceId END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceId), 0) AS percentage FROM results AS res JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

c.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN res.time IS NOT NULL THEN res.raceId END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceId), 0) AS completion_percentage FROM results AS res JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese' AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

b.request: For races from 2007 through 2009 with at least one Japanese driver in the results, calculate the percentage of distinct races in which at least one Japanese driver has a non-null result time, counting each raceId once in both counts
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN res.time IS NOT NULL THEN r.raceId END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId), 0) AS percentage FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009 AND d.nationality = 'Japanese';
